hook: Why Queen Victoria Proposed to Albert
text: In October, eighteen thirty-nine, Prince Albert came to Windsor Castle. Within five days, Victoria's mind was made up. Because she was the Queen, it was not proper for him to propose to her. She had to ask him. So on the fifteenth of October, she sent for him to come to her private room, and there, alone, she asked him to marry her. He said yes. She wrote that it was the happiest, brightest moment of her life.
